# www.fixesau.com

> Find verified local electricians, plumbers, carpenters, and cleaners in minutes. Get AI-powered quotes and pay securely.

[Fixes | Hire Trusted Tradies Instantly](https://www.fixesau.com): Find verified local electricians, plumbers, carpenters, and cleaners in minutes. Get AI-powered quotes and pay securely.

## Categories

[Trade Categories | Fixes — Find Tradies by Trade](https://www.fixesau.com/categories): Browse all trade categories on Fixes. Find licensed electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, painters, carpenters, cleaners, and more across Australia.
[Electrician | Fixes — Hire Trusted Electricians](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/electrician): From replacing light switches and installing power points to full switchboard upgrades — our verified, licensed electricians handle it all. Every sparky on Fixes is background-checked, insured, and rated by real customers.
[Hire HVAC & Refrigeration Tradies | Fixes](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/hvac): Split system installs, ducted system repairs, air conditioning re-gas and filter replacement — our HVAC technicians keep your home comfortable year-round.
[Plumber | Fixes — Hire Trusted Plumbers](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/plumber): Leaking taps, blocked drains, burst pipes, hot water repairs — our licensed plumbers are ready to handle any plumbing emergency or scheduled maintenance. Transparent pricing, no call-out surprises.
[Plasterer | Fixes — Hire Trusted Plasterers](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/plasterer): Hole patches, ceiling cracks, cornice repairs, and full room re-plastering. Our skilled plasterers deliver flawless finishes every time.
[Carpenter | Fixes — Hire Trusted Carpenters](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/carpenter): From fixing sticking doors and building decks to fence repairs and custom shelving — our carpenters bring craftsmanship and reliability to every project.
[Painter | Fixes — Hire Trusted Painters](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/painter): Room repaints, exterior touch-ups, feature walls, fence staining — our painters bring colour and life to your home with precision and care.
[General Labourer | Fixes — Hire Trusted General Labourers](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/labourer): Get practical help with heavy lifting, moving, material handling, demolition assistance, and general site labour.
[Flooring | Fixes — Hire Trusted Floorings](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/flooring): Vinyl plank, hardwood, tiles, carpet — whether you need new flooring installed or damaged boards replaced, our flooring specialists deliver beautiful results.
[Other | Fixes — Hire Trusted Others](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/other): Describe a job that does not match one of the listed service categories and we will help identify the right service.
[Emergency Make Safe Services | Fixes](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/emergency): Exposed wiring, burst pipes, storm damage, gas leaks — when safety is at risk, our emergency tradies respond fast to make your property safe. Available 24/7.
[Handyman | Fixes — Hire Trusted Handymans](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/handyman): Get help with furniture assembly, TV mounting, minor non-licensed repairs, and odd jobs around your property. For regulated electrical, plumbing, HVAC, or building work, choose the relevant licensed trade category.
[Hire Gardening & Landscaping Experts | Fixes](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/gardening-landscaping): Book help with lawn mowing, pruning, garden cleanup, planting, turf, and basic landscaping. Larger specialist projects can be assessed from your job details and photos.
[Cleaning | Fixes — Hire Trusted Cleanings](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/cleaning): Standard cleans, deep cleans, end-of-lease, move-in, commercial, carpet, window, and post-renovation cleaning — our professional cleaners leave every space spotless.
[Roofing | Fixes — Hire Trusted Roofings](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/roofing): Book verified roofers for leak diagnosis, tile and metal roof repairs, gutters and drainage, skylights, restoration, storm damage, and full roof replacement. Provider licensing is checked against the work scope and Australian jurisdiction.
[Waste Removal | Fixes — Hire Trusted Waste Removals](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/waste-removal): General household waste, green waste, construction debris — our waste removal teams handle collection and responsible disposal so you don't have to worry.
[Auto Care | Fixes — Hire Trusted Auto Cares](https://www.fixesau.com/categories/auto-care): Book mobile car washing and detailing, or choose workshop drop-off where available. Share vehicle details and clear photos so the quote reflects the vehicle condition, size, and service scope.
